items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: And Bernie Peacock was in the band and a fella named Palmer on drums, from what I could remember, and I worked with him there.

ctx.x: Having looked back over the tape, I want to get a little more clarity on that period just before you went with Kelly Martin's Band.

Well, I worked with Jimmy Lucky in Grand Rapids, Michigan. He was a trumpet player and a very fine musician. And Bernie Peacock was in the band and a fella named Palmer on drums, from what I could remember, and I worked with him there.
